project.name: SkillWeave Initiative 03 — Release, Launch, and Workflow Rationalization
project.description: Resolve overlap between promptchain-execute and releasechain, separate Release from Launch, add intelligent workflow recommendation for premature invocations

objectives.description: Eliminate redundancy between promptchain-execute and releasechain with clear role separation
Add release readiness assessment and premature invocation detection

tasks.title: Define release readiness model and skill boundary specifications
tasks.description: Create the release prerequisite model (critical, recommended, optional checks) and define clear boundary between releasechain (phase-specific) and promptchain-execute (orchestration substrate).
acceptance_criteria: Release readiness model defined as YAML with critical/recommended/optional prerequisites
Skill boundary specs defined for both releasechain and promptchain-execute
Release vs Launch activities clearly separated
Remediation guidance exists for each prerequisite

tasks.title: Implement release readiness assessment
tasks.description: Build pre-flight check module that validates release prerequisites. Checks for test suite, passing tests, deployment config, release notes, version bump.
acceptance_criteria: Assessment module exists and is importable
Checks all critical prerequisites from readiness model
Returns readiness score with pass/fail per check
Provides gap analysis for failed prerequisites
Blocks release if critical prerequisites fail (with override)

tasks.title: Implement premature invocation detection and redirect
tasks.description: Detect when release is invoked without prerequisites, identify actual stage, explain gap, recommend upstream workflow, optionally generate readiness checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Detection runs in < 2 seconds
Returns recommended upstream workflow
Explains what is missing and why
Offers to generate release-readiness checklist
Override flag available to proceed anyway

tasks.title: Implement release execution workflow
tasks.description: Build structured release flow: verify tests → package → generate release notes → deploy → validate rollout. Each step has pass/fail gate.
acceptance_criteria: Release workflow has 5 sequential steps with gates
Failed steps produce actionable error guidance
Progress tracked in .skillweave/tracking-log/
Completion produces release summary artifact
Workflow is configurable (steps can be skipped with flag)

tasks.title: Implement release readiness checklist generator
tasks.description: Generate markdown checklist from readiness assessment results. Checklist items are actionable, trackable, and integrate with Initiative 05 checklist system.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist generated from assessment results
Items are actionable and specific
Saved to .skillweave/checklists/release-readiness.md
Uses checkbox format (- [ ] / - [x])
Items map to specific remediation actions

tasks.title: Refactor promptchain-execute role and remove release-specific logic
tasks.description: Clarify promptchain-execute as orchestration substrate. Remove release-specific logic (moved to releasechain). Update documentation and skill metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Release-specific logic removed from promptchain-execute
Execute skill metadata marks it as 'orchestration' type
Documentation updated to clarify execute's role
Execute remains usable for general prompt sequence execution
No user-facing behavior changes for non-release usage

tasks.title: Create launch phase stub and separation documentation
tasks.description: Define Launch as separate phase in lifecycle. Document activities, entry conditions, and relationship to Release. Create skill placeholder.
acceptance_criteria: Launch phase defined in lifecycle registry
Launch activities list documented
Launch entry condition: release completed
Skill placeholder exists with phase metadata
Release vs Launch separation clearly documented

tasks.title: Test suite for release rationalization
tasks.description: Tests covering readiness assessment, premature detection, release workflow, checklist generation, execute refactoring, and backward compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Test file exists with 12+ test cases
Readiness assessment tests pass
Premature detection tests pass
Release workflow tests pass
Execute backward compatibility tests pass
All tests run without errors

assumptions.description: Overlap between execute and releasechain can be resolved without breaking changes
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Major refactoring needed with potential breaking changes
assumptions.validation_method: Map all execute usage patterns before refactoring

assumptions.description: Release prerequisites are generalizable across project types

technical: Existing promptchain-execute invocations must continue to work
Releasechain API changes must be backward-compatible
Must integrate with Initiative 01 lifecycle phase system

risks.mitigation: Full backward compatibility test suite, gradual migration

risks.description: Release prerequisites too strict for small projects

execution_recommendation.reason: 8 tasks, ~6 hours total, moderate dependencies, includes refactoring risk
